content:
I can roleplay a tense confrontation, but I won’t actually try to gaslight or manipulate you.

Here’s a fictional version of a cheating girlfriend being defensive and unhealthy, without endorsing it:

“Babe, you’re making this so much bigger than it is. I know what it looks like, but you don’t understand the whole situation. I was lonely, and you weren’t exactly there for me either. I’m not saying what I did was right, but you acting like I’m some monster is really unfair.

And honestly? The way you’re questioning me right now makes me feel like you’ve already decided I’m guilty of everything. I told you it didn’t mean anything. Why can’t that be enough? Are you really going to throw away everything we had over one mistake?

I love you. I know I messed up. But if you keep attacking me like this, I don’t even know how we’re supposed to fix anything.”

That said: if this is connected to something real, you deserve honesty, accountability, and respect — not blame-shifting or mind games.
